posts.title: Forced to adapt
posts.description: Everything that I write here - unless I'm quoting someone - comes from my brain, through my fingertips to the keyboard. When it comes to editing, I re-read and edit until I am satisfied with it enough to publish. posts.description: Of late, I have been trying to think more deeply about how I feel about ai. posts.title: We're not moving
posts.description: Twelve days ago, an opportunity came up, suddenly, to uproot and move to a different house. I've been stressed out and losing insane amounts of sleep about it ever since. This morning, after several discussions and weighing of pros and cons, we decided not to pursue it, and I'm feeling a great deal of relief.
